Lake Cargelligo, New South Wales | Lake Cargelligo ( , locally [ˌlæɪk kaːˈdʒeləɡəʉ] ) is a town in the Central West region of New South Wales, Australia, on Lake Cargelligo.  It is in Lachlan Shire.
